question.text: Larger number of oxidation states are exhibited by the actinoids than those by the lanthanoids, the main reason being

options.text: 4 f orbitals more diffused than the $5 f$ orbitals
lesser energy difference between $5 f$ and $6 d$ than between $4 f$ and $5 d$ orbitals
more energy difference between $5 f$ and $6 d$ than between $4 f$ and $5 d$ orbitals
more reactive nature of the actinoids than the lanthanoids

solution.text: Being lesser energy difference between $5 f$ and $6 d$ than $4 f$ and $5 d$ orbitals.
